      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp to fix btck_script_pubkey_verify() copying caller-supplied txdata on every call.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The change fixes an unintended copy of PrecomputedTransactionData in the kernel C API on every script verification invocation caused by a ternary expression mixing lvalues and prvalues. While it fixes an API defect, the kernel C API is still experimental and the impact is contained to callers supplying precomputed data."
    },

      "name": "mempool",

      "name": "tests",

      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "None."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the Consensus label and modifies sighash precomputation in the script interpreter and block connection in src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "This PR hardens script execution by eliminating an error-prone lifecycle hazard where cached BIP143 and BIP341 sighash data could theoretically carry over across transactions. Enforcing transaction and spent-output context at construction time closes a dangerous misuse path, alongside a minor allocation optimization when skipping script checks during assumevalid block connection."
